meta.title: Continue button
meta.description: Adds a「继续」button under the composer: one click re-runs a session that stopped unexpectedly, and a network drop or an upstream cut (output limit) resumes itself 1–3 s after the link recovers.

button.sent: Sent — the task is running again
button.waitingNetwork: Waiting for the network to come back…
button.noAgent: No live agent for this session; open it and try again

tip.default: Re-runs a session that stopped unexpectedly. After a network drop or an upstream cut (output limit) it clicks itself once the link is back.
tip.offline: Offline — it will resume automatically when the link returns.
tip.idle: No interruption detected. Clicking still sends a「继续」.
